description:
## Goal

Derive the one final InputDemand(F) answer directly from source-owned LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, exact protocol/provider facts, and peer InputDemand values. Activation identity is the resulting canonical observation class, not an input arrow plus an auxiliary discriminator.

## Output contract

InputDemand retains normalized typed semantic questions with ordered operand bindings. Questions include dispatch predicates, equality/order, executable type membership, shape/content, returned denotation, and callable identity. Local and acyclic transport is exact. Recursive approximation, if unavoidable, is explicit, sound, finite, and measured.

Do not preselect a DFA, powerset query engine, or other representation in the ticket. Begin with paper examples and prove the smallest final-consumer-owned algebra. Any automaton/index must be unavoidable, bounded, shared, consumed in this commit, and cheaper than the implementation it removes.

## Authorities

- LoweredBody remains the sole operation/value/control denotation. Borrowed owner-qualified refs or indexes may locate existing data but copy no meaning.
- EntryDispatch, StaticCallees and protocol/provider facts remain separate only at their real dependency boundaries.
- ActivationInputs is the sole exact correlated input-row authority.
- Root and caller discovery publish exact rows from their real owners. Delete SeedActivation key-to-row reconstruction and the historical RootSlot activation-key set used to guard it.
- Typed comparisons use the World-owned memo keyed by operation and interned immutable operands. No display string or raw Ty order is identity.

## Required semantic laws

Preserve direct, delivered, projected, reconstructed, tuple/list/map/bitstring, protocol and callable-identity observations; coherent control-edge tuples; repeated-versus-distinct operand identity; same-callee callsite isolation; discarded delivery; explicit success/failure/Halt; exact map key identity; base-return dependence beside recursive rebuilt arguments; and conservative recursive soundness.

fz-kdt.188 must first remove blended Cartesian ActivationInputRows. fz-kdt.213 supplies generic grounded retraction. fz-kdt.46 and fz-tfn.6 supply exact producer and activation-appearance edges. fz-tfn.57 supplies exact source replacement ownership.

## Required deletion

Delete InputFlow types, producer/store, alias closure, lineage expansion and relation-only tests; the private InputDemand cone/SCC/query solver; Whole/coarse structural demand; BodyKeying::consumes_callable_identity; key-derived evidence; RootSlot historical activation keys; SeedActivation reconstruction; compatibility bridges, transition telemetry, probes and stale docs.

## Signal and acceptance

Cold, unchanged, unrelated edit, relevant edit, recursive ground removal, callsite isolation and three-door production fixtures prove exact semantic answers. Equal answers retain allocation/generation and wake nobody. Total deterministic semantic/product work is lower than the pre-fz-kdt.214 baseline; no improvement may discard a real may-dependency. No per-question product traversal or global graph rescan survives.

This ticket absorbs the valid acceptance laws of fz-kdt.214, fz-kdt.220, fz-kdt.75 and fz-kdt.165, plus the InputDemand-specific cutover formerly described by fz-kdt.213.

The one divergent shape found (self-nesting accumulator) hangs at base with no forwarding at all -- fz-kdt.177's class, not this.

title: Derive final InputDemand directly from source-owned bodies
